map.R 越大越好？: Is a larger R always better?
map.R 大→可分辨更小波长差，光谱仪分辨邻近谱线能力更强。: A larger R resolves smaller wavelength differences, so a spectrometer can better separate neighbouring spectral lines.
map.与瑞利角分辨关系？: What is the relation to the Rayleigh angular resolution?
map.二者同源：瑞利给最小分辨角，分辨本领 R=λ/Δλ=D/(1.22λ)。: They share an origin: Rayleigh gives the minimum resolvable angle, and the resolving power is R=λ/Δλ=D/(1.22λ).
